verdict.rationale: Ollama has a public GitHub repository, so an open-source contribution path is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no contribution guide, pull-request process, contributor recognition, or maintainer path; the GitHub items only describe integrations, models and the REST API. Hosting code on GitHub is a host-platform fact and earns no credit toward a documented contribution-and-recognition process.

support.subject: As a developer, I can contribute code and become a recognized collaborator through the project's open-source process
